claim: Each Basket keeps its own list of lines, so adding something to Ana's basket never changes Ben's total.
why: Basket.__init__ gets its list from new_lines("basket"), which reads like a factory that returns a fresh list. It is wrapped in lru_cache, so every call with the same argument returns the same list object. Running main.py shows Ben's basket holding Ana's pens and a total of 1040 instead of 800.

deciding.note: the lines list is shared across baskets

root.claim: Adding to Ana's basket never changes Ben's total.

atoms.claim: Each Basket gets its own list of lines
atoms.evidence: new_lines is decorated with lru_cache, so new_lines("basket") returns the same list every time. main.py prints ben's lines as [('pen', 2), ('ink', 1)]: Ben sees Ana's pen line.

atoms.claim: Ben's total is unaffected by Ana's add
